blurb: Current Culture Fly offers guided fly fishing trips targeting species like shad, striper, largemouth bass, red drum, brook trout, and musky in various Virginia locations. They also provide fly fishing classes for all skill levels and sell custom fly fishing gear and apparel. Trips include lunch on full day outings and are led by US Coast Guard licensed captains or experienced guides.
